name: Claymorphic
description: Soft clay: pill controls and deep, puffy corners, borderless cards modelled by a soft drop shadow with a lit top edge and a shaded underside, soft thick rules in a tinted accent, chunky padding, a ring that floats clear of the pill, and squishy motion that overshoots.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's clay recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: Expressive state motion: hovers swell and presses squash more than in a quiet language.
Its enter motion, spring-in, and emphasis motion, bounce-once, have no keyframes in the platform yet, so they don't animate.

tokens.shadow-overlay: 0 18px 36px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 26%, transparent), inset 0 -6px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 10%, transparent), inset 0 6px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 60%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: 0 12px 24px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 22%, transparent), inset 0 -6px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 10%, transparent), inset 0 6px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 60%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-inset: inset 4px 4px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 16%, transparent), inset -4px -4px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 70%, transparent)
